name: Spread Philhellenism
description: By elevating [ShowCultureGroupName('greek_group')] learning, art, and philosophy, we seek to shape how our realm is perceived both at home and abroad. Scholars, artists, and admirers of [ShowCultureName('greek_culture')] culture are drawn to us, strengthening our splendor and influence through admiration rather than force.

name: Encourage [ShowLanguageNameWithNoTooltip('latin_language')] Militarism
description: We shall bind our realm to the [ShowLanguageName('latin_language')] ideal of ordered war: contracts enforced, drills standardized, and the burden of arms made routine. Such discipline will surely reduce the cost of keeping soldiers in the field and foster a professional tradition of service.

name: Aid Constantinople
description: This will set our Cabinet to develop [ShowLocationName('constantinople')] and its [province|e], ensuring it stays as the jewel of our nation.

name: Alleviate Concerns
description: This will decrease our [antagonism|e] monthly.

name: Appease Estate
description: This will increase the [estate|e]'s [estate_satisfaction|e].

name: Aptekarsky
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of health and medicinal related matters, allowing for better distribution of medicines and rapid distribution of any knowledge concerning potential treatments.

name: Assimilate Area
description: As a [ShowHegemonyName('cultural_hegemon')] we can promote a culture over a larger area of the country at once.

name: Promote Council of the Empire
description: The Council of the Empire is a custodian of foreign influences, reducing the [cabinet|e] power of native [estates|e] in favor of the crown, whilst focusing on improving our [diplomatic_reputation|e] by fostering better relations with other countries.

name: Bolshogo Dvortsa
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the maintenance of palaces and the reduction of court-related expenses. Religious monasteries are also overseen to ensure they are aligned with state doctrine and abide by the law.

name: Accelerate Bureaucratic Entrenchment
description: Our cabinet can be directed to actively push bureaucratic structures toward entrenchment, speeding up the consolidation of our administrative order and making these institutions harder to dislodge.

name: Reduce Bureaucratic Upkeep
description: Our administration is dependent on many bureaucratic cornerstones, many of which are old and costly to maintain. Assigning a capable cabinet member to oversee their operations will cut down on the upkeep they demand from our treasury.

name: Extensive Conscription
description: During times of war and when our faith is at risk, as we struggle to protect what is holy, it falls upon our shoulders to call all able-bodied pious men to serve and donate their dues against our heathen foes.

name: Diplomatic Corps
description: As a [ShowHegemonyName('diplomatic_hegemon')] we have a way to support our diplomats to make them more capable and efficient.

name: Maritime Support
description: As a [ShowHegemonyName('naval_hegemon')] we can use our government to support our maritime efforts.

name: Change Societal Values
description: This allows us to focus on a change on a specific [societal_value|e].

name: Counterespionage
description: This will protect our [country|e] against other countries that attempt to build up their [spy_network|e] in our country.

name: Develop Province
description: This is the best way to increase [development|e] in the selected [province|e]. This is probably what you want to do when you have nothing currently urgent to do.

name: Diplomatic Endeavors
description: This will affect a fair amount of [diplomacy|e] that our [country|e] tries to do. Primarily it will help with things where the [opinion|e] of other countries matters.

name: Encourage Migration
description:
This will make [pops|e] more likely to [migrate|e] to this [location|e].

Note: the cabinet assignment also speeds up [migration|e] across all owned locations, not just the selected one.

name: Expel People
description: This will force [pops|e] to [migrate|e] away from this [province|e].

name: Foster New Culture
description: Form an entirely new [culture|e] that will become our [primary_culture|e].

name: Frustrate Annexation
description: By hindering their delegates with archaic constitutional legislature and obstructing them at every turn, we can increase the amount of time it will take for our [overlord|e] to [annex|e] us.

name: Gǎitǔguīliú Policy
description: This will increase the assimilation of any foreign [culture|e] and our $celestial_authority$ gain.

name: Aclla Recruitment
description:
Our cabinet will focus on gathering the most beautiful and intelligent girls of the realm to train them to become Acllas, allowing them to serve the state for [royal_marriage|E] and [ShowCharacterInteractionName('aclla_distribution')].
The amount of eligible [characters|E] we will gain varies between #Y 2#! and #Y 7#! in #Y 4 years#!.

name: Increase Province Control
description: This will slowly increase our [control|e] in the selected [province|e]. This can be useful when circumstances have changed, and we quickly wish to increase control.

name: Increase Area Control
description: This will slowly increase our [control|e] in the selected [area|e]. This can be useful when circumstances have changed, and we quickly wish to increase control.

name: Integrate Area
description: When we have conquered an [area|e], we need to [integrate|e] it before it will be a part of our [country|e]. If it does not become integrated, the [pops|e] in the area may [rebel|e].

name: Integrate Province
description: When we have conquered a [province|e], we need to [integrate|e] it before it will be a part of our [country|e]. If it does not become integrated, the [pops|e] in the province may [rebel|e].

name: Ispolneniya Zakonov
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of judicial matters and law enforcement, optimizing the implementation of legal decisions and sentences, as well as maintaining law and order.

name: Kazenny
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of the treasury, streamlining the collection of taxes and keeping state expenditures in check.

name: Egalitarian Integration
description: This will make our [population|e] be [promoted|e] and [assimilated|e] more quickly, while bolstering our armies.

name: Enforce $sharia$ Administration
description: An honest and precise interpretation of the $sharia$ will greatly supplement our administrative efficiency and improve our efforts towards safeguarding our values.

name: Reintegrate the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip]
description: When we have retaken a [province|e] within [ShowScriptedGeographyName('frankokratia_geography')], we need to [integrate|e] it before it will be a part of our [country|e].

name: Promote $catholic$
description: This will increase the amount of [pops|e] that will [convert|e] to $catholic$ each month.

name: Maintain Grand Trunk Road
description: This will set our [cabinet|e] to maintain the Grand Trunk Road

name: Unify Culture Group
description: [merged_culture_group_merge] one of the [culture_groups|e] of our [primary_culture|e] into a new [culture|e].

name: Militarize Country
description: This will let our cabinet focus on improving the military capabilities of our [country|e], and increase the discipline of our [armies|e].

name: Integrate Lombard Claims
description: Our quest to unite the former lands of the Lombard Kingdom is but a noble and legitimate one.

name: Promote [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('nahuatl')] Reformation
description: Faith is the beating heart of our people and the sacred bond between our rulers, our gods, and the world. New teachings must be guided with care, so they do not fracture the balance that sustains our lands and our destiny. By appointing a trusted voice of the court to oversee this sacred work, we will hasten the reform and ensure it brings strength instead of unnecesary unrest.

name: Noblesse Oblige
description: $increase_control_province_desc$

name: Office of New Converts
description: A [cabinet_member|e] is assigned to manage the Office of New Converts, devoted to the conversion of heathen souls. Operating in [ShowLocationName('kazan')], it takes an assertive approach to speed up conversion through any means necessary, sending a powerful and provocative message that all must adhere to the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] faith.

name: Bolster Navy
description: This will set our [cabinet|e] to bolster our [navy|e].

name: Integrate Swahili Province
description: To exert our influence in the [ShowRegionName('swahili_coast_region')] we must make sure the [pops|e] there are properly accepted into our realm and integrated without the need of force.

name: Pacify Population
description: This will decrease the [unrest|e] of the local [population|e].

name: Oversee Labor Rights
description: While we ensured the rights of our laborers and farmers, we can only ensure their wellbeing with direct oversight in a [province|e].

name: Encourage Urbanization
description: This will make our [population|e] to be [promoted|e] more quickly.

name: Posolsky
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of foreign affairs, improving the integration of subjects and ensuring good relations with other [countries|e].

name: Assimilate Pops into our Culture
description: This will convert the local [population|e] to the target [culture|e].

name: Convert Province
description:
This will increase the amount of [pops|e] that will [convert|e] to the selected [religion|e] each month.

Only the country's [primary_religion|e] and religions within the same [religion_group|e] that have at least 1% presence in the country may be selected.

name: Deal With the Robber Barons
description: The local Robber Barons are a threat to our hold over the province and to our prestige even more. We must get rid of them for the good of our splendor! And perhaps for the good of the local peasantry, too.

name: Razryadny
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of military affairs, overseeing the distribution of military supplies and weapons, and overseeing the recruitment and organization of the [army|e].

name: Rebel Crackdown
description: [rebels|e] cannot be allowed to foment instability in our [country|e]. We will target a rebel faction and crack down hard on them.

name: Recovery Effort
description: This is the best way to recover from negative [prosperity|e] in the selected [province|e]. This could be vital after a war or a plague.

name: Reduce Inflation
description: This is the best way to reduce [inflation|e] in our [country|e]. We can also mint fewer coins, but that may affect our balance.

name: Reduce $war_exhaustion$
description: This will reduce our [war_exhaustion|e].

name: Reduced Paperwork
description: As a [ShowHegemonyName('economic_hegemon')] we can use our government to make sure our economy is more efficient.

name: Reform Taxation System
description: The inept local governors in charge of extracting tax have long-lost their meager ability to do so. It is up to our highest councils now, to correct this and reform our taxation system. A grueling process that may take a few years, it is a necessary step to help us see through the current crisis.

name: Boost Colonial Charter
description: Force our [pops|e] to migrate into one of our [colonial_charters|e].

name: Send People to the Colonies
description: Force our [pops|e] to migrate into a [ShowSubjectTypeName('colonial_nation')].

name: Send Secret Royal Inspectors
description: This will increase our [control|e] in our selected province drastically.

name: Settle the Frontier
description: The [cabinet|e] will put efforts into settling the uncolonized [province|e] with a band of [pops|e].

name: Settle $tribesmen$
description: We will slightly encourage [ShowPopTypeName('tribesmen')] to become [ShowPopTypeName('peasants')]

name: Soldiers as Workforce
description: As a [ShowHegemonyName('military_hegemon')] we can use our government to improve all types constructions in the country.

name: Sow Disloyalty
description: By spreading cruel rumors about our [overlord|e] and espousing the benefits of ruling ourselves, we can decrease our own [subject_loyalty|e], potentially becoming a [disloyal_subject|e].

name: Stabilize Country
description: This is one of the three main ways to increase [stability|e] in our [country|e]. Another one depends on the ratio of Clergy in the country and the final one depends on how much of our [budget|e] we are willing to spend on it.

name: Streltsy
description: This will let our cabinet focus on the prikaz of musketeers, which includes overseeing their recruitment, training, organization, and their responsibilities for internal security and law enforcement.

name: Strengthen Government
description: This is the best way to immediately strengthen our [government_power|e]. There is no other way for us to directly affect it easily.

name: Stroganov Influences
description: Having a member of the Stroganov dynasty's assigned to cabinet allows players to channel the family's wealth, power, and historical ties to the salt industry for significant benefits.

name: Foster Institutions
description: This focuses our cabinet on speeding the spread of an [institution|e] that is already reaching the selected [province|e] through trade, neighboring lands, or our market. It hastens adoption where an institution has begun to take root, but cannot conjure one in a [province|e] it has yet to reach.

name: Support Patriarchate
description: This will let our cabinet focus on supporting the religious leader, gaining us [Player.GetReligion.GetReligiousInfluenceLink].

name: Support New Farms in North or East
description: We are supporting [ShowCultureName('finnish')] and [ShowCultureName('swedish')] settlers in the north to colonize and populate the new lands.

name: Taluqdar Tax Collection
description: This will allow us to collect significantly more tax from our [estates|e].

name: Align Estate
description: This will increase the [estate|e]'s [estate_satisfaction|e].
